about: A soft, finely haired muzzle with no pad (horse, donkey, mule, zebra).
rules: The muzzle ends in a blunt face about 0.7 of the cheek width, never a point; the nostril ring flares wider than the mid-face.
Nostrils are large C-shaped hollows on the front corners: near-black inside, a lit fleshy rim, a shadowed groove above.
A broad rounded upper lip overhangs a mouth crease; a separate rounded chin sits under it with a notch above and below.
About 16-20 vertices: nostril ring 6-8, lip ring with the crease 6, end cap 4, chin 1-2.
